name: solace-agent-plugins
description: Solace-owned marketplace of AI agent skills for building applications on the Solace platform

plugins.name: solace-messaging-skills
plugins.description: Skills for building applications on the Solace platform. Includes solace-application-development (designs and generates Solace messaging code grounded in canonical Solace docs), solace-topic-best-practices (looks up the canonical Topic Architecture Best Practices page online for topic-hierarchy questions), and solace-messaging-feedback (formats a session into copy-paste-ready feedback routed to the Solace Ideas portal, Solace Support, or the Solace Community)

plugins.name: solace-docs
plugins.description: Solace documentation lookup. Includes solace-docs (locates the right docs.solace.com page from a bundled sitemap and reads the current page online as Markdown, so answers quote the live Solace documentation instead of model memory)
